title: Greer's groups call up lights on a nearby Florida beach
place_text: Beach about 40 minutes south of Cocoa Beach, Florida

plain: A man named Steven Greer takes groups to a Florida beach about 40 minutes south of Cocoa Beach, where they try to call up lights in the sky, according to Charles Buhler, who has worked at NASA. Buhler says it is almost the same beach where he himself has been, and he passes on what he knows of Greer's visits rather than describing one he attended. The point of the story is that the same stretch of shore seems to draw this kind of activity.
